question: When Jesus told Judas, "What you are about to do, do quickly," what did some disciples think it meant?
options: Judas was going to fetch water
Judas was to buy what was needed for the festival or give to the poor
explanation: John 13:29 says since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.
